evidence.quote: 7 Semester : 3.5 years standard period of study
Language : The language of instruction is German / English.
The curriculum is offered in German and in English.
The following tuition fees apply for applicants from: non-EU countries 1,500 EUR
Newly enrolled international students not from EU/EEA countries have to pay tuition fees of 1,500 € per semester.

notes: Applicant is a non-EU (Moroccan) applicant with a foreign diploma, so the non-EU tuition fee of EUR 1,500 per semester is the relevant one (stated by DAAD for applicants from non-EU countries and by HHN for international students not from EU/EEA countries). Application deadlines come from the DAAD page (15 July for winter, 15 January for summer); the years shown are the next occurrences, since the pages give no year. Deadlines are for applicants from all countries. A semester contribution of EUR 188 per semester is additional and is not included in the tuition amount. The programme is restricted-admission, so an early application is advised. The IBIS document list is taken from the page 'Application documents for International Applicants', which links directly to IBIS; the VPD/recognition path for foreign certificates is stated on the university's Master application page, which explicitly addresses applicants with international certificates (the VPD requirement for international applicants is general to HHN).
